title: Conon the Briton
summary: Raleigh names Conon the Briton in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Conon the Briton, whose retrait with six thousand men from Aquileia through Italie and France, in despite of Theodosius, he compares with Xenophon his march. He is not Conon the Athenian. The one-word title would fold onto that record, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
